description: NaSCN crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two NaSCN sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. Na is bonded to two equivalent N and three equivalent S atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaS₃N₂ square pyramids. Both Na-N bond lengths are 2.46 Å. There are two shorter (2.97 Å) and one longer (3.02 Å) Na-S bond length. C is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one N and one S atom. The C-N bond length is 1.19 Å. The C-S bond length is 1.63 Å. N is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. S is bonded to three equivalent Na and one C atom to form corner-sharing SNa₃C tetrahedra.
